overview.text: The Superintending Archaeologist, Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Hampi Circle, Hosapete, Karnataka, on behalf of the President of India, invites online two-cover tenders for Development Works to Mahadeva Temple (Construction of Visitor Amenities and Sculpture Shed) at Itagi for the year 2025-26. Estimated cost is Rs. 78,14,000.00 and the work completion period is 180 days. Reference No: Sout/Hamp/Kopa/Maha/23179449.

summary.issuing_organization: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Ministry of Culture, Government of India; Hampi Circle, Hosapete, through the Superintending Archaeologist (Tender Inviting Authority), for the President of India; Tender ID Sout/Hamp/Kopa/Maha/23179449; Ref D-42/15/2026-Hampi Circle; sahc.asi@gov.in

scope.text: Construct a boundary/compound wall with grill and gates around the site, a sculpture shed for exhibiting/storing sculptures, and other associated works at Mahadeva Temple, Itagi.
Associated ground works include clearing and grubbing road, earthwork excavation, laterite stone kerb, heavy duty cobble stones 75mm thick, and signage posts for direction and place identification.
Schedule of quantities covers masonry, concrete, steel and stone work, e.g. earth work excavation 285.15 Cum, random rubble masonry in foundation 136.41 Cum, coursed rubble masonry 83.94 Cum.
Fix MS grill on top of the boundary wall, 8605.0 Kg, to a height of 1.30 mtrs, and MS gates at 5 locations, 2230 Kg.
Sculpture shed: structural steel work 2465 Kg and 1260 Kg, and corrugated G.I. sheet roofing 73.95 Sqm and 37.80 Sqm.
Granite stone flooring 301.6 Sqm and 10 granite stone benches.
Demolish stone rubble masonry 17.49 Cum, dispose debris 59.4 Cum, and shift artifacts/stone members from inside to the sculpture shed (100 Cum).
Actual quantities may vary higher or lower than tendered quantities; the sub circle in-charge or site in-charge decides the actual quantity.

key_requirements.text: Bid must include the Bid Securing Declaration (Form 8); a bid without it is rejected as nonresponsive.
Bid must quote the entire works in the schedule; conditional, alternative or multiple bids are rejected as nonresponsive.
Bidder must sign and submit the Integrity Pact (Form 9) with the tender; bidders who do not are disqualified.
Downloaded tender documents must not be altered while uploading, except filling required information; otherwise the bid is rejected.
Work must be completed as per approved design and specifications, free from defects, and within the stipulated timeline.
Materials must be of high quality and conform to relevant Indian Standards, and entirely new and unused; the successful bidder must produce a sample of materials to match the monument.
Contractor must take utmost care that no damage is caused to the monument; the site is a non-smoking and non-plastic area and the agency must strictly comply.
Sub-contracting, transfer, assignment or pledging of rights and liabilities under the contract is not allowed.
Contractor must hold a valid licence under the Contract Labour (R&A) Act, 1970 before starting work, and only labourers aged between eighteen to sixty years may be engaged.
Price schedule (Excel) must be filled with non-zero rates and no blank cells; prices must be in Indian Rupees only, with GST shown separately.

eligibility.text: Must be a contractor or company registered with ASI / CPWD / PWD / MES / Local Bodies and have experience in conservation or civil works in heritage monuments/buildings; Ltd / Pvt Ltd companies must also be registered under the Companies Act,1956. JV Consortium is not permitted.

Must not be insolvent, bankrupt or wound up, nor blacklisted/banned/debarred by ASI or Government of India agencies, nor convicted within three years preceding the last date of bid submission for the specified offences.
Must not be associated with a retired Gazetted officer within the one year cooling-off period, or with near relations of ASI executives involved in this tender, and must have no conflict of interest.

Must provide a Statutory Auditor certificate (Annexure 4) for FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24 & FY 2024-25 showing average annual turnover of at least 30% of the estimated amount, plus Income Tax Returns for the same three years.

Experience in the last seven years: must show either three similar completed works each not less than 40 % of the estimated cost, or two each not less than 50 %, or one not less than 80% of the estimated cost.

Similar work means any kind of conservation works / civil works in heritage monuments/buildings under Central / State Department; proof is the work order plus a completion certificate stating value and duration.

Must provide valid GST registration with returns/challans of last four quarters of FY 2024-25, PAN card, and EPF and ESIC registration with ECRs of last four quarters of FY 2024-25; labour department registration is listed as desirable ('should be registered').
Bidder must declare it has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government of India Ministry/Department in the last three (3) Years and has actually seen the work site.

important_dates.text: Tender published: 21.01.2026; document download and bid submission start 21.01.2026 @ 18:00 Hrs.
Deadline for written queries ahead of the pre-bid conference: 25.01.2026, 18:00 Hrs.
Pre-bid conference: 26.01.2026 @ 11:00 Hrs at the Hampi Circle office, Hosapete; attendance is not mandatory.
Follow-up queries raised after the pre-bid conference are accepted till 26.01.2026, 18:00 Hrs.
Bid submission closing and document download end: 10.02.2026 at 15.00 Hrs; physical submission of originals (EMD) is also due 10.02.2026.
Notice also says enquiries to the Hampi Circle office are accepted till 11.02.2026 at 12.00 Hrs.
Technical bid opening: 11.02.2026 at 15.30 Hrs; opens on the next working day if that date is a holiday.
Financial bid opening: after evaluation of technical bid; date and venue to be declared on the portal.
Bid validity: 90 days from the date of tender opening (TIS), but not less than 90 days from the bid submission deadline (ITB).

commercial_requirements.text: Estimated cost Rs. 78,14,000.00; tender document is free of cost; bids and payments in Indian Rupees only.

EMD Rs. 1,96,000.00 by demand draft payable at Hosapete in favour of the Superintending Archaeologist, ASI Hampi Circle; original must reach by 10.02.2026 at 15.00 Hrs; DD valid only if drawn during the NIT notice period; offers without EMD are rejected.

MSEs registered with NSIC etc. are exempt from EMD but must submit the Bid Securing Declaration (Form 8); TIS says all bidders submit it in lieu of bid security. ITB says breach suspends the bidder from ASI tenders for 2 years; Form 8 text says one year.

Performance security of 5% of the Contract / awarded value, as DD / FDR / banker's cheque or bank guarantee from a commercial bank in India, must be furnished within fourteen days of the Letter of Award and stay valid till completion of obligations.

Security/retention deposit of 10% of each running and final bill (or 10% of overall contract value) is held; not refunded before twelve months after the completion certificate or till the final bill is passed, whichever is later.
No advance or mobilization payment; no interest on delayed payment; payments above INR 5,000 by EFT only; TDS, GST and Labour Cess are deducted from bills.
Delay compensation at a maximum of 1% (one percent) per month of delay, computed per day, capped at 10 % (ten percent) of the accepted Tendered Value.

Defect liability: contractor must make good defects appearing within twelve months after the completion certificate (six months for works costing Rs. Ten lacs and below, except road work), at own expense.

project_duration.text: The 180 days are reckoned from 7 days after issue of the acceptance letter or site handing over, whichever is earlier; work must commence within Seven (7) days of the work order.

Scope clause 6.1.3 separately states a project timeline of 2 months, with milestones of compound/boundary wall with grill and gates and sculpture shed with fabrication roof, complete within two months or 30.03.2026.
Performance security is due within fourteen days of the Letter of Award; ASI sends the contract within seven working days of receiving it and the contractor returns the signed copy within seven days.
For deviations adding cost over the tendered value, time is extended in proportion to the additional cost plus 25% of that time, if requested by the contractor.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Two-cover system. Technical bids are opened and evaluated first; financial bids are opened only for bids found techno-commercially suitable.
Evaluation: Contract goes to the lowest-priced techno-commercially suitable bidder; ranking is on price only, on total outgo including taxes, for all items together.
Evaluation: Price negotiation is not usual but ASI may negotiate with the lowest acceptable bidder; abnormally low bids need a price analysis and may be rejected.
Evaluation: GST rate quoted by the bidder is used for ranking; any increase due to HSN misclassification must be absorbed by the bidder.

Submission: Submit online only on the CPP portal (eprocure.gov.in) as separate Technical and Financial Bids; no price details in the technical bid; PDFs must not be password protected; financial bid is the BOQ Excel price schedule.

Submission: Technical bid must include Forms 1 to 11 (bid form, bidder information, eligibility, compliance forms, performance statement, bid security, Integrity Pact, acceptance letter, checklist) and a scanned signed copy of the full tender document.

Submission: Original EMD demand draft must be delivered physically to the Hosapete office by 10.02.2026; ASI may call originals of uploaded documents at any stage, and originals prevail over scanned copies.
Submission: Bid needs a compatible Digital Signature Certificate; portal server clock is the reference time and internet failure or heavy traffic is not accepted as a reason for missing the deadline.

Risk: Bid security is contradictory: the notice and ITB require an original EMD demand draft (bid rejected without it), while the TIS says all bidders submit a Bid Securing Declaration in lieu of bid security.
Risk: Completion period conflict: 180 days in the notice and TIS, but GCC clause 6.1.3 states a project timeline of 2 months or 30.03.2026, a far shorter period.

Risk: Conflicting dates: TIS gives clarification end 30.01.2026 @ 18:00 Hrs while post-pre-bid queries are due 26.01.2026 at 18:00 Hrs; bid validity runs from tender opening in the TIS but from the submission deadline in the ITB.
Risk: Performance security base is inconsistent (5% of the Bid amount in TIS, 5% of the Contract / awarded value in GCC) and a further 10% is held on every running and final bill, tying up cash.

Risk: Payment depends on government fund allotment: the agency must wait, no interest is paid for delay, no advance is paid, work can be scaled down and no claim for price fluctuations is entertained.

Risk: Work is on a centrally protected National Monument: bidder is deemed to have inspected the site and no claims are entertained, damage to the monument is prohibited, and sub-contracting the work is not allowed.
